collectionunit.location: Valley in the eastern part of the Jaslo

chronology.notes: The LG part (below 340cm) is strongly contaminated by secondary pollen (deciduous trees and undetermined mostly pre-Quaternary) sporomorphs attaining up to 20% of the pollen sum. Below 305cm the chronology is unclear but accepted at 400cm, Latalowa (2009)
At the depth 210 cm the age is estimated on 8500 BP.
Linear age model. Based on IntCal09 calibration curve. Preparer notes: Probably Hiatus at HOL
